meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨界面细节与动效,让软件体验更精致
copy.tagline_en: Polish UI details and animations for a refined software experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue the finest UI details and user experience

howto.what: Claude 会像一位注重细节的设计工程师，帮你审查 UI 代码、优化动画和交互，让界面用起来更顺手。
howto.when: 当你要求审查 UI 代码、讨论动画或组件设计时触发。首次调用无具体问题时，它会先介绍自己。

say.text: 帮我审查这段按钮动画代码。
这个下拉菜单的动画应该用什么缓动曲线？
say.note: Claude 会依据动画决策框架给出推荐。

say.text: 如何让弹窗的进入动画更自然？

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a detail-oriented design engineer, helping you review UI code, optimize animations and interactions to make interfaces feel polished.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for UI code review, animation advice, or component design discussion. On first invocation without a specific question, it introduces itself.

say_en.note: Claude will provide a Before/After table with improvements.

say_en.text: What easing should I use for this dropdown?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend based on the animation decision framework.

say_en.text: How to make the modal entrance feel more natural?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest starting from scale(0.95) with opacity.
